meta.model_notes: Two-point linear model: fixed intercept + variable $/sf. Anchored at 1900sf (Lipscomb reference) and 800sf (synthetic). Variables derived as: rate = (cost@1900 - cost@800) / 1100. Update synthetic 800sf column and refit when second real project data is available.
